question: The ______ unit is that part of the CPU which controls or directs the operations of the processor.
solution:
The correct answer is __**control.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **control unit **is a key component of the **CPU (Central Processing Unit)** that **directs the operation of the processor.**
 
• It interprets the instructions that come from memory and transforms them into signals that control other parts of the computer, essentially acting as a director for the various operations within the processor.
 
• The control unit **does not carry out any actual data processing operations**, but rather delegates those tasks to other components in the computer.
 
• It often uses a binary decoder</strong
